hypothesis_queue.physical_signature: A normalized cross-scale gravity-to-magnetic admittance residual: a short-scale gravity edge that persists while the magnetic edge is smoothed or demagnetized, gated by basin cover and low relief.
hypothesis_queue.missing_fault_rationale: A buried or cover-obscured basement discontinuity can retain a density edge without producing a mapped surface scarp; it therefore targets a missing fault rather than copying the catalogue geometry.
hypothesis_queue.non_fault_mimic: An unfaulted intrusive or volcanic lithologic contact with density contrast but weak magnetic contrast; flight-line leveling seams are a second acquisition confounder.
hypothesis_queue.difference_from_repo: No existing lane in this repository combines the two scale differences across gravity and RTP as one residual. MRR is within-magnetic residualization; PHASE is angular discordance; GTHC is upward-continuation/amplitude logic.
hypothesis_queue.external_data: none; uses the restored cached stack

hypothesis_queue.physical_signature: Terrain-bin-matched radiometric K:Th residual with along-strike coherence, rather than a global radiometric high.
hypothesis_queue.missing_fault_rationale: Hydrothermal alteration or soil redistribution along a covered structure may persist in shallow radiometry even when a discrete scarp is absent; matching relief reduces the mapped-scarp shortcut.
hypothesis_queue.non_fault_mimic: K-rich transported alluvium, parent-rock boundaries, and radiometric soil-moisture effects.
hypothesis_queue.difference_from_repo: MVRD uses radiometric evidence with scarp fields; this candidate tests a terrain-matched conditional null and does not use catalogue geometry for its surface.
hypothesis_queue.external_data: none; all named layers are already restored

hypothesis_queue.physical_signature: Repeated, signed cross-channel drainage offsets normalized within catchment and channel-order strata, with a matched pseudo-crest null.
hypothesis_queue.missing_fault_rationale: A blind rupture crossing several independent channels can leave repeated baseline offsets even when all individual scarps are below mapping confidence; replication is the missing-fault criterion.
hypothesis_queue.non_fault_mimic: Lithologic knickzones, inherited drainage capture, and regional base-level or climate change.
hypothesis_queue.difference_from_repo: QTSK/TDKL rank absolute knickwaves or scarp polarity; FARC requires cross-catchment replication against a channel-matched null, a different statistic.

hypothesis_queue.physical_signature: Depth-conditioned temperature-to-conductivity residual: a local thermal anomaly that is not explained by regional conductance or basin depth.
hypothesis_queue.missing_fault_rationale: A focused fluid pathway can produce a thermal response offset from a broad conductive basin halo and may mark a blind permeable fault; the residual is designed to target the mismatch.
hypothesis_queue.non_fault_mimic: Lake-brine conductivity, groundwater circulation, and unfractured permeable lithology.
hypothesis_queue.difference_from_repo: DHTC combines deep heat/MT and basement structure; TCONS is a conditional residual with head-matched negative controls and no direct vent label.
hypothesis_queue.external_data: none for the cached owner-mirror stack; official GDR license must be rechecked before sharing derivatives

hypothesis_queue.physical_signature: Multi-sensor edge persistence after an explicit flight-line-direction artifact veto and local cross-sensor continuity test.
hypothesis_queue.missing_fault_rationale: A fault-related edge should persist across independent sensors and not be confined to the documented east-west survey-line direction; this can recover a concealed discontinuity while rejecting a processing seam.
hypothesis_queue.non_fault_mimic: Common gridding artifacts, tie-line leveling, and broad lithologic contacts that align with acquisition direction.
hypothesis_queue.difference_from_repo: MGC/XGCE reward cross-field edge geometry but do not apply a preregistered flight-direction null; FLAC is a robustness/control transform, not a new data source.
hypothesis_queue.external_data: none; GeoDAWN acquisition metadata are official context, not a new raster
